theorems.name: Submission.allard52_am_center_density
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (y : Amb n ℓ) (F : ℝ → ℝ) (R Λ α : ℝ), 0 < R → 0 < α → μ (closedBall y R) < ⊤ → (∀ r ∈ Ioo 0 R, Real.exp (-Λ) ≤ F r ∧ F r ≤ Real.exp Λ ∧ |F r - 1| ≤ Λ * (r / R) ^ α) → (∀ s r : ℝ, 0 < s → s ≤ r → r < R → F s * (s ^ n)⁻¹ * (μ (closedBall y s)).toReal + F s - 1 ≤ F r * (r ^ n)⁻¹ * (μ (closedBall y r)).toReal + F r - 1) → ∃ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t ∧ Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => μ (closedBall y r) / ENNReal.ofReal (unitBallVolume n * r ^ n)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (ENNReal.ofReal t)) ∧ ∀ r ∈ Ioo 0 R, unitBallVolume n * t ≤ F r * (r ^ n)⁻¹ * (μ (closedBall y r)).toReal + F r - 1
